listed_quote.quote: Fidelity’s bond and money market mutual funds.

announcement.quote: To strengthen and simplify our money market product line, we are also proposing to merge several funds that have similar investment strategies.

deals.notes: Money market mutual funds (open-end), not exchange-listed. Seq 9 names three mergers: U.S. Government Reserves into Government Money Market Fund; Select Money Market Portfolio into Money Market Fund; Prime Fund - Daily Money Class into Government Money Market Fund. Only the Select Money Market Portfolio pair is recorded here; the other two are equally unlisted. No excerpt states the vote result or completion.

problems: Excerpts do not say which role the Salem Street Trust fund plays; target and acquirer CIKs not shown.
